Containers C and D contain the same ideal gas. The gas in container C is at a temperature of 500 K. The pressure in C is a third of the pressure in D. The volume of C is five times the volume of D. There are four times as many molecules in D than in C. What is the temperature in D?

  1. -198 C
  2. 75 C
  3. 348 C
  4. 1200 C
